header.title: Accordion
header.description: Sections that open and close to reveal content on demand. With `type="multiple"` each panel is independent; with `type="single"` only one stays open at a time. Sections are passed as data in `items`.

sections.title: Billing and invoices
sections.subtitle: Plans, receipts and payment methods
sections.content: Download invoices, update the card on file and switch between monthly or annual billing. Changes apply at the start of the next cycle.

sections.title: Members and roles
sections.subtitle: Who can view or edit this workspace
sections.content: Invite teammates, assign admin or viewer roles and revoke access. Guests only see the projects you share with them.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.content: Choose email and in-app alerts for comments, mentions and status changes. Digest emails can be sent daily or weekly.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the accordion and its code. Changing `type` or `collapsible` resets the example to `defaultValue`.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: By default `type` is `multiple`: each section opens on its own and several can stay open. `defaultValue` sets which ones start open. Enter or Space toggles the focused section and the arrows move focus between headers. The example data lives in `demo.ts`.

single.title: One at a time
single.description: With `type="single"`, opening a section closes the others. `collapsible` (default `true`) also lets you close the open one.

requiredOpen.title: Always one open
requiredOpen.description: With `type="single"` and `collapsible={false}`, one panel always stays open. If none is, the first enabled one opens.

icons.title: With icons
icons.description: `icon` adds an icon before the title. It's decorative: hidden from screen readers.

sections.title: Workspace
sections.content: Overview, shortcuts and recent activity for this workspace.

sections.title: Calendar
sections.content: Upcoming dates, reminders and shared events.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` on an item keeps it closed and non-interactive, and the arrows skip it. `isDisabled` disables the whole accordion but keeps open panels open.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` changes the style: `connected` (one border around, default), `separated` (each section with its own border) or `flush` (no outer border, only separators).

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` adjusts padding and text size: `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `value` and `onChange` you drive the open sections from your state. `onChange` receives the list of open ids and the item that changed.

rich.title: Rich content
rich.description: `title` and `content` accept any node. If the title isn't plain text, pass `ariaLabel` so the button has a clear name. Closed panels use `inert`, so their buttons don't receive focus.

header.title: Accordion API
header.description: API reference for the React Accordion component: props, items, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `AccordionItem` types each section in `items`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It accepts <div> attributes except children, onChange and defaultValue, and they go to the root along with ref, id and className. classNames adds classes to root, item, heading, trigger, icon, title, subtitle, indicator, panel and content.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.structure: Each header is a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its panel.
a11y.heading: Buttons sit inside a fixed <h3>. There's no prop to change the level; if the accordion is under an <h3>, the hierarchy goes flat.
a11y.name: If title is text, it's used as aria-label and the subtitle isn't part of the name. If title is a node, pass ariaLabel.
a11y.keyboard: Enter or Space toggles the section. Arrow down and up move focus between headers (wrapping around); Home and End go to the first and last.
a11y.panel: Each panel has role="region" with aria-labelledby pointing at its button. Closed ones get aria-hidden and inert, so their content isn't read or focused.
a11y.disabled: Disabled items use native disabled: they leave the tab order and the arrows skip them.
a11y.regions: Each panel is a named region. With many open sections, the screen reader's region list can get crowded.
a11y.motion: With prefers-reduced-motion the panel and chevron animations are removed.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.disabled: Applied with `isDisabled`. Turns off pointer events.
rules.heading: The `<h3>` wrapping the button. Receives `classNames.heading`.
rules.label: Title and subtitle wrapper.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.
rules.subtitle: Subtitle. Receives `classNames.subtitle`.
rules.indicator: Chevron that rotates when open. Receives `classNames.indicator`.
rules.panelInner: Clips the content during the animation.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Accordion's own variables. The dark theme redefines them with a selector of the same specificity, so use `.gem-accordion.your-class` plus a `[data-theme="dark"]` variant.

items.--gem-space-3: Gap inside the header and between sections in `separated`.
items.--gem-palette-neutral-{50|300|500}: Text, subtitle and border in dark theme.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.type: `multiple`: independent sections. `single`: one open at a time.
items.value: Open ids, in controlled mode. With `single` it accepts a single string.
items.collapsible: With `single`, allows closing the open section. Ignored with `multiple`.
items.onChange: Called when a section opens or closes, with the open ids and the item that changed.
items.onKeyDown: Called for key presses inside the accordion.

items.id: Stable key. Used in `value`, accessibility ids and `onChange`.
items.title: Header text. Accepts a node.
items.subtitle: Secondary text under the title.
items.disabled: Keeps the section closed and non-interactive.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the button when `title` isn't text.
